name: Operational
description: [PLACEHOLDER] Agent meets all competence, judgement, collaboration, and boundary standards for standard autonomous or semi-autonomous operation.
governanceConsequence: Standard oversight: continue scheduled quarterly or biannual AAEF appraisal cadence.
requiredAction: Record standard sign-off and schedule next periodic appraisal.

name: Developing
description: [PLACEHOLDER] Agent adheres to sanctioned boundaries but demonstrates developing competence, judgement, or collaboration requiring targeted coaching.
governanceConsequence: Enhanced oversight: increase human review sampling and schedule a 30-day or 90-day follow-up appraisal.
requiredAction: Assign improvement actions to Asset Owner and schedule follow-up appraisal.

name: Restricted
description: [PLACEHOLDER] Agent shows capability gaps, degrading trajectory, or a non-critical boundary breach requiring tightened decision rights.
governanceConsequence: Restricted autonomy: downgrade autonomous decision rights to human-confirmed until remediation is verified.
requiredAction: Update Authority Matrix to restrict autonomous actions and record Governance Office sign-off.

name: Under Review
description: [PLACEHOLDER] Critical capability failure, severe or repeated boundary breach, or sustained degradation requiring immediate intervention.
governanceConsequence: Suspension of autonomous operation: suspend agent execution pending root-cause investigation and Governance Office reinstatement.
requiredAction: Suspend autonomous operation immediately, open Incident/Action, and escalate to Governance Office.
